name: io.github.flashdata-dev/youtube-channel
title: YouTube Channel Data — FlashData
description: YouTube channel profiles and recent video inventories. Paid FlashData API.

environmentVariables.name: FLASHDATA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your FlashData API Key with youtube_channel access. Get a key at https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys; data calls are paid.

dev.flashdata.task: Snapshot a channel and its recent video inventory
dev.flashdata.useResult: Read results[0] for channelId, channelHandle, name and videos. Retain each videoId and available metrics so your application can compare later snapshots.
dev.flashdata.limits: video_limit is 1 to 100; fewer videos or missing statistics are possible. A recent-video snapshot is not a complete historical archive.
dev.flashdata.installation: Local MCPB / stdio; Node.js >=22.18.0; set your own FLASHDATA_API_KEY in protected client settings. See guideUrl for manual setup.
dev.flashdata.billing: MIT software and installation are free. FlashData data calls use paid Credits. Pricing/job/result reads are free; client and model fees are separate.
